data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Wallpaper order mismatched and hung up on being resolved](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/641e1f84b23781c84235684a)
Upon placing an order for 5 rolls of one pattern of wallpaper on March 4th - all to be hung in the same room - I first became concerned when I received only 2 rolls of the 5 rolls ordered on March 10th. While I believe a phone call would be the best manner in which to handle this matter, I had to send an email because phone calls aren't accepted. I hoped my concern about receiving all rolls of wallpaper from the same batch so as to match would be handled exponentially. I did receive a reply both on March 13th and March 14th informing me the fulfillment team had been notified and wallpaper from the same batch already received would be shipped to me. I received the remaining 3 rolls of the same wallpaper pattern on March 23rd - 2 of the rolls in the order are from one batch number and the other from another batch number and not any of the 3 match the batch number of the 2 received on March 10th. I have sent another email regarding this mess of an order and am awaiting a reply with how this will be resolved.

March 23, 2023

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Mar 28, 2023

Hi Denise,

Thank you for reaching out and we are terribly sorry you were shipped wallpaper from different dye batches. We see you are currently working on this with our customer experience team and we are working on ensuring this does not happen again. Again, we thank you for your feedback and you will be hearing from our team soon.
